description: This file defines the `DestroyCandidatePurgeStrategy` class within the `OrangeHRM\Maintenance\PurgeStrategy` namespace. It extends a base class `PurgeStrategy` and includes a `purge` method that deletes candidate entities that do not have consent to keep their data, based on provided vacancy ID.

classes.name: DestroyCandidatePurgeStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class for purging candidate data that users did not consent to keep, based on vacancy ID.

methods.name: purge
methods.description: Deletes candidate records associated with a given vacancy ID if they have not consented to data retention.
